schema_snippets.media_names:
CREATE TABLE `media_names` (
  `medID` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `Media_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Is_minimal` enum('Y','N') CHARACTER SET latin1 COLLATE latin1_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`medID`)
schema_snippets.media_compounds:
CREATE TABLE `media_compounds` (
  `medcompID` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `medID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `compID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Amount_mM` float DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`medcompID`),
  UNIQUE KEY `unique_combo` (`medID`,`compID`),
  KEY `compound_IDs` (`compID`),
  KEY `media_IDs` (`medID`),
  CONSTRAINT `compound_IDs` FOREIGN KEY (`compID`) REFERENCES `compounds` (`compID`),
  CONSTRAINT `media_IDs` FOREIGN KEY (`medID`) REFERENCES `media_names` (`medID`) ON UPDATE CASCADE
schema_snippets.compounds:
CREATE TABLE `compounds` (
  `compID` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `KEGG_ID` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `BiGG_ID` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `seed_id` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pubchem_ids` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `chebi_ids` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `formula` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`compID`),
  UNIQUE KEY `KEGGID_unique` (`KEGG_ID`),
  UNIQUE KEY `BiGGID_unique` (`KEGG_ID`,`BiGG_ID`)
schema_snippets.growth_data:
CREATE TABLE `growth_data` (
  `growthID` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `strainID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `medID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `sourceID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Growth_Rate` float DEFAULT NULL,
  `Growth_Units` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pH` float DEFAULT NULL,
  `Temperature_C` float DEFAULT NULL,
  `Additional_Notes` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `contributor_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `approved` tinyint(4) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`growthID`),
  UNIQUE KEY `unique_conditions` (`strainID`,`medID`,`sourceID`,`Growth_Rate`,`pH`,`Temperature_C`),
  KEY `growth_strainID` (`strainID`),
  KEY `growth_medID` (`medID`),
  KEY `growth_sourceID` (`sourceID`),
  CONSTRAINT `growth_medID` FOREIGN KEY (`medID`) REFERENCES `media_names` (`medID`) ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `growth_sourceID` FOREIGN KEY (`sourceID`) REFERENCES `sources` (`sourceID`) ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `growth_strainID` FOREIGN KEY (`strainID`) REFERENCES `organisms` (`strainID`) ON UPDATE CASCADE
schema_snippets.sources:
CREATE TABLE `sources` (
  `sourceID` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `First_Author` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Journal` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Year` year(4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Link` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pubmed_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`sourceID`),
  UNIQUE KEY `Title_UNIQUE` (`Title`),
  UNIQUE KEY `Link_UNIQUE` (`Link`)
